versions.name: Montana Outdoor High Adventure Base (MOHAB)

features.note: Ultralight backpacking treks in the Bob Marshall Wilderness Complex.
Multi-sport wilderness treks combining backpacking with packrafting.
Conservation curriculum covering Leave No Trace and local ecosystem knowledge.

versions.summary: Backcountry high-adventure base on the Boone and Crockett Club's Theodore Roosevelt Memorial Ranch near Dupuyer, Montana, offering one-week crew treks.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features survey attempted 2026-07-25: the page is rich, but the vocabulary then had no codes for wilderness trekking, so nothing could be recorded. Backpacking/mountaineering/caving/packrafting codes were added afterwards — re-queued for survey. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).

notes: Council announced on the camp's own page that MOHAB will PAUSE after the 2026 season: no operation in 2027 or 2028, with a decision on 2029 to be made by the end of 2027. operating_status remains `active` because the pause has not taken effect - the 2026 season is in progress. Re-check after the 2026 season and set `not_operating` (the property exists; only the program stops), not `closed`. Note the same page still advertises 2027 dates and fees alongside the pause announcement; the dated announcement is authoritative and the schedule block is stale.
